summary: Skratch showcases what he considers the absolute strongest and most busted team in Dragonheir: the Toxin team centered around Serpentemis. Through her passive Bone-Seeping Poison and the continuous application of poison ticks by teammates, enemy waves and dungeon bosses are melted in literal seconds. The build completely blitzes Outlands Rift in 0 seconds, clears Stage 18 Frost Domain waves instantly, and clears Challenge Mode dungeon bosses like Grave of Venom and Grave of Curse in 10-12 seconds. It also outputs between 14 and 17+ billion damage in Temporal Vortex against the Arbor Hydra even at Inspiration 1.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.verdict: Absolute best AoE / Toxin carry in the game
heroes.note: Her passive triggers explosive derivative Poison damage whenever poisoned enemies take hit damage, melting waves and bosses instantly even at Inspiration 1.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Provides passive synergy that accelerates poison procs alongside Serpentemis.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.verdict: Insanely good for wave-clearing and dungeon speedruns
heroes.note: His passive triggers instant multi-target attacks and poison applications at battle start, but falls off in Temporal Vortex boss fights.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.verdict: Essential single-target and boss-oriented Toxin enabler
heroes.note: Applies consistent poison stacks needed to constantly trigger Serpentemis's damage in boss content like Temporal Vortex.

heroes.name: Vicana
heroes.note: Usable poison unit, though not quite at the top tier of synergy.

heroes.name: Jathalea
heroes.note: Focuses on Thorny Poison, which functions differently and does not supply the standard Toxin ticks this team requires.

teams.note: Four-man core that obliterates waves and dungeon bosses in 0 to 12 seconds with no healers or supports required.

teams.mode: Frost Domain Stage 18 & Dungeon Challenge Mode
teams.note: All-poison lineup using Lava Batwing as familiar; relies on Durango holding Lunar Radiance Helm to survive initial hits.
Hit 14B to 17B+ total damage on simulation runs; creator expects 20B+ at Inspiration 5.

tips: Serpentemis scales heavily off Enlightenment and Attack to maximize her derivative poison bursts.
Put the Mythic helmet Lunar Radiance Helm on Durango to grant him immortality and damage reduction upon fatal damage, keeping him alive long enough to trigger full team skills.
Skip farming Heretical Ruins and Ancient Battlefield on Challenge Mode as the rewards are not worth the investment.
title: The Strongest Team in Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
